statement.zh: 将青关山简单定为「古蜀王宫殿」仍属功能诠释，需更多建筑学与出土情境约束。
statement.en: Calling Qingguanshan simply the ‘ancient Shu royal palace’ remains a functional interpretation needing tighter architectural and contextual constraints.
